lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters; a primary vertical alignment of five distinct macro-blobs is positioned posterior to the gill slits, followed by approximately four subsequent columns extending towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect horizontal rows of blobs, creating visible anchor nodes that define a grid-like structural pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the most prominent ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient with a high-luminance superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance spots within the fin boundary; approximately 10 discrete circular clusters are localized primarily on the lower half and anterior edge of the dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced gradient in spot size and density, transitioning from high-frequency micro-spots on the rostrum and head to low-frequency macro-spots on the trunk.
